ModMetaData.name: XenoPreview
ModMetaData.author: coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: XenoPreview adds female and male pawn previews to the xenotype creation screen. The previews update as you select genes. Lock, reroll, and rotate each pawn separately, toggle clothes, show or hide tattoos when Ideology is active, or minimize the window when you do not need it. The mod stores no save data, so you can add or remove it during a playthrough. Original idea from the RimWorld Discord: https://discord.com/channels/214523379766525963/1372022155193225226
